_note: Market events. calendar = fixed days. random = seeded, a few per week. Every event shows a signal first (feed post, Seller Hub headline, inbox message, comments). Effect kinds: heatAdd{add}, push{stage}, reach{mult}, conv{mult}, dealSpend{mult}, crowd{add}, cost{mult}, supplierDelay{minutes}, returns{add}, patience{mult}, courierDelay{minutes}. Effect target: {kind:all} or {kind:product,id} or {kind:trait,id} or {kind:site,id} or {kind:randomProduct,pool:[ids]}; an effect without target uses the event target. Templates in text: {product} {celeb} {site} {trait}. Calendar windows are in days from the start of the event day (0 = 0:00 of that day).
